description: This PHP class defines a custom widget for SuiteCRM, specifically a button in a subpanel that allows creating a new marketing email campaign associated with a focus record. The class extends a base subpanel button class and generates an HTML link with an onclick handler to navigate to a marketing wizard page.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopCreateCampaignMarketingEmailButton
classes.description: A widget class rendering a button to create a new marketing email campaign related to a focus record in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Generates an HTML link that, when clicked, redirects the user to the 'WizardMarketing' action, passing the current record's ID and module as URL parameters.
